description: Email authentication posture of a domain from DNS (Cloudflare DNS over HTTPS): MX records and null MX, SPF parsed into mechanisms with its all qualifier and a recursive DNS-lookup count against the RFC 7208 limit of 10, DMARC policy (p, sp, pct, alignment, report addresses' domains), MTA-STS and TLS-RPT records, and BIMI. DKIM is not assessed because selectors cannot be enumerated. Returns an A-F grade and 0-100 score with weighted reasons. Price: $0.003 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

domain.description: Bare domain, hostname, email address or URL. Scheme, path, port and credentials are stripped and IDNs are converted to punycode. IP addresses and private names are rejected.

name: domain_email_auth
title: Email authentication posture (SPF, DMARC, MTA-STS)
